subject: Question about Confidence Interval of EFA model

messages.author: 6a27ddaa75dc3b38
messages.subject: Question about Confidence Interval of EFA model
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to fit a EFA Model without Individual SNP Effects using Genomic SEM. Is there any way to get confidence intervals for the loadings? It would help me to confirm the directions and magnitudes of the loadings between my phenotypes and factors.

Thanks,
Zicheng

messages.author: ac421cf36d1a4c37
messages.subject: Re: Question about Confidence Interval of EFA model
parts: In the example on the wiki, we use the factanal function from the stats package to run the EFA on the ldsc-derived S matrix. This doesn't use V, so there are no SEs. To get SEs I would recommend using the EFA solution to guide your specification of a CFA within Genomic SEM using usermodel, which uses V and outputs SEs. You can use SEs to get CIs the standard way.
